title: OS command execution via ProcessBuilder (kotlin) — review required
description: The kotlin sink ProcessBuilder launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via ProcessBuilder with an args list.
remediation: Use ProcessBuilder with an args list with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any ProcessBuilder call matches.
